# Security

firsthour shows text from third-party sources (Hacker News, company job boards) that it does not control. Titles are rendered as text only and links are built from validated ids, never copied from content. It has no accounts and stores nothing about visitors.

If you find a security issue (e.g., script injection through a job title, a link that escapes the allowed hosts), open an issue. We will respond within 7 days.
